name: sig_carve
description: A signature scan: find where known file headers (magic bytes) occur in a binary file, in one pass over it, and count every offset: the first max_hits of each signature come back with a preview (up to 32 bytes in hex and 64 as ASCII, none when context is 0), and every hit is in all_results when there are more. It carves nothing and estimates no size: a hit is where the bytes occur, not a file, so cut a decisive hit with file_carver (or read it in place) and check it with a parser of that format. Each header is found once, at its true offset, whatever the read size; an unknown signature name is an error, not an empty result. SCCA hits name candidate_start (the hit minus 4). The answer says which file and what range were scanned; a scan that reaches its time budget (about 100 seconds) answers for the range it covered, says scanned.complete: false and scanned.stopped, and names where to go on (start), with exit 0 (the engine ran); a read error exits 1. The file is read as given: an E01 or other container is its container bytes, not the disk inside. earlier_answers says how many other files answer the same scan.

path.description: Path to the binary file to scan

context.description: Preview bytes from each hit (0 to 4096, default 64)

max_hits.description: Hits returned inline per signature (default 500); every hit is in all_results when there are more (a file that cannot be written is said in all_results_error, and the count stays whole)

start.description: Byte offset to scan from (default 0): the way to go on after a scan stopped at its time budget, which says where. A header that begins before it and ends after it is found once; one wholly before it is not this scan's.

window_bytes.description: Read block size (16 to 256 MiB, default 8 MiB); results do not depend on it
